analysis_summary: PowerShell was launched with an encoded command. Decoding the provided value yields `Write-Host 'Test'`, which is a benign-looking test message. The evidence confirms PowerShell execution but does not establish malicious intent or show what command launched the parent cmd.exe.
potential_false_positives: An administrator, user, or test script may have used an encoded PowerShell command for benign testing or automation.
The command is encoded, but its decoded content is only a test message; encoding alone does not establish malicious activity.
recommended_actions: Review the full command line and surrounding process events for the parent cmd.exe, if available.
Check nearby endpoint events for additional PowerShell commands or related activity.
Confirm whether user Akul or an authorized test process was performing this action at the recorded time.
Avoid treating this event as malicious based on the encoded-command flag alone; escalate only if surrounding evidence provides additional context.
